```{python}
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib as mpl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
from matplotlib.path import Path as MplPath
from matplotlib.patches import PathPatch, Rectangle


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    while not (path / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
        if path.parent == path:
            raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
        path = path.parent
    return path


def format_count(value):
    return f"{int(value):,}".replace(",", ".")


def format_percentage(value, total):
    return f"{100 * value / total:.1f}".replace(".", ",")


root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
source = root / "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/tourism-accommodation-vila-seca-geocoding.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(source)
data["registered_places"] = pd.to_numeric(data["registered_places"], errors="raise")

expected_types = ["Hotels", "Càmpings", "Apartaments Turístics", "Autocaravanes"]
if len(data) != 17 or data["registered_places"].sum() != 9985:
    raise RuntimeError("Unexpected Vila-seca accommodation snapshot: expected 17 establishments and 9,985 places")
if set(data["establishment_type"]) != set(expected_types):
    raise RuntimeError("Unexpected establishment types in the Vila-seca accommodation snapshot")
if set(data["municipality"]) != {"Vila-seca"}:
    raise RuntimeError("The accommodation snapshot must contain only Vila-seca records")


def category_group(row):
    category = row["category"]
    if row["establishment_type"] == "Hotels" and category not in {"4 estrelles superior", "4 estrelles"}:
        return "Altres categories d'hotel"
    return category


data["category_group"] = data.apply(category_group, axis=1)
category_order = [
    "4 estrelles superior",
    "4 estrelles",
    "Altres categories d'hotel",
    "3 estrelles",
    "Sense categoritzar",
]

type_values = data.groupby("establishment_type")["registered_places"].sum().reindex(expected_types)
category_values = data.groupby("category_group")["registered_places"].sum().reindex(category_order)
flows = data.groupby(["establishment_type", "category_group"])["registered_places"].sum()
total = int(data["registered_places"].sum())

if type_values.isna().any() or category_values.isna().any():
    raise RuntimeError("Missing a required type or category in the accommodation flow")
if int(type_values.sum()) != total or int(category_values.sum()) != total:
    raise RuntimeError("The accommodation flows do not conserve the registered-place total")

type_colors = {
    "Hotels": "#2878a5",
    "Càmpings": "#2a9d8f",
    "Apartaments Turístics": "#e9b949",
    "Autocaravanes": "#d96c4d",
}

mpl.rcParams.update(
    {
        "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
        "svg.fonttype": "none",
        "svg.hashsalt": "tigit-sankey-allotjament-vilaseca",
    }
)

gap = 0.018
scale = (0.70 - gap * (len(category_order) - 1)) / total
node_width = 0.022
x_total, x_type, x_category = 0.08, 0.43, 0.80


def node_layout(order, values):
    height = sum(values[item] * scale for item in order) + gap * (len(order) - 1)
    cursor = 0.50 + height / 2
    layout = {}
    for item in order:
        top = cursor
        bottom = top - values[item] * scale
        layout[item] = (bottom, top)
        cursor = bottom - gap
    return layout


total_height = total * scale
total_node = {"Vila-seca": (0.50 - total_height / 2, 0.50 + total_height / 2)}
type_nodes = node_layout(expected_types, type_values)
category_nodes = node_layout(category_order, category_values)


def draw_ribbon(ax, x0, interval0, x1, interval1, color, alpha=0.70):
    bottom0, top0 = interval0
    bottom1, top1 = interval1
    control0 = x0 + 0.45 * (x1 - x0)
    control1 = x1 - 0.45 * (x1 - x0)
    vertices = [
        (x0, bottom0),
        (control0, bottom0),
        (control1, bottom1),
        (x1, bottom1),
        (x1, top1),
        (control1, top1),
        (control0, top0),
        (x0, top0),
        (x0, bottom0),
    ]
    codes = [
        MplPath.MOVETO,
        MplPath.CURVE4,
        MplPath.CURVE4,
        MplPath.CURVE4,
        MplPath.LINETO,
        MplPath.CURVE4,
        MplPath.CURVE4,
        MplPath.CURVE4,
        MplPath.CLOSEPOLY,
    ]
    ax.add_patch(PathPatch(MplPath(vertices, codes), facecolor=color, edgecolor="none", alpha=alpha))


total_cursor = total_node["Vila-seca"][1]
for establishment_type in expected_types:
    value = type_values[establishment_type]
    interval = (total_cursor - value * scale, total_cursor)
    draw_ribbon(
        plt.gca(),
        x_total + node_width,
        interval,
        x_type,
        type_nodes[establishment_type],
        type_colors[establishment_type],
    )
    total_cursor -= value * scale

type_cursors = {item: interval[1] for item, interval in type_nodes.items()}
category_cursors = {item: interval[1] for item, interval in category_nodes.items()}
for establishment_type in expected_types:
    for category in category_order:
        value = int(flows.get((establishment_type, category), 0))
        if not value:
            continue
        source_interval = (type_cursors[establishment_type] - value * scale, type_cursors[establishment_type])
        target_interval = (category_cursors[category] - value * scale, category_cursors[category])
        draw_ribbon(
            plt.gca(),
            x_type + node_width,
            source_interval,
            x_category,
            target_interval,
            type_colors[establishment_type],
            alpha=0.66,
        )
        type_cursors[establishment_type] -= value * scale
        category_cursors[category] -= value * scale

fig = plt.gcf()
fig.set_size_inches(11, 6.2)
fig.set_facecolor("white")
ax = plt.gca()
ax.set_facecolor("white")
ax.set_xlim(-0.16, 1.12)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.set_axis_off()


def draw_nodes(nodes, x, colors):
    for name, (bottom, top) in nodes.items():
        ax.add_patch(
            Rectangle(
                (x, bottom),
                node_width,
                top - bottom,
                facecolor=colors[name],
                edgecolor="#17202a",
                linewidth=0.7,
                zorder=4,
            )
        )


draw_nodes(total_node, x_total, {"Vila-seca": "#263746"})
draw_nodes(type_nodes, x_type, type_colors)
draw_nodes(category_nodes, x_category, {item: "#dce5ea" for item in category_order})

label_box = {"facecolor": "white", "edgecolor": "none", "alpha": 0.88, "pad": 1.8}
ax.text(
    x_total - 0.012,
    0.50,
    f"Allotjament convencional\n{format_count(total)} places",
    ha="right",
    va="center",
    fontsize=10.5,
    fontweight="bold",
    color="#17202a",
)

type_label_offsets = {"Apartaments Turístics": 0.018, "Autocaravanes": -0.018}
for name, (bottom, top) in type_nodes.items():
    value = int(type_values[name])
    ax.text(
        x_type + node_width + 0.010,
        (bottom + top) / 2 + type_label_offsets.get(name, 0),
        f"{name}\n{format_count(value)} · {format_percentage(value, total)} %",
        ha="left",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.4,
        color="#17202a",
        bbox=label_box,
        zorder=5,
    )

category_labels = {
    "4 estrelles superior": "4 estrelles superior",
    "4 estrelles": "4 estrelles",
    "Altres categories d'hotel": "Altres categories d'hotel¹",
    "3 estrelles": "3 estrelles",
    "Sense categoritzar": "Sense categoritzar",
}
for name, (bottom, top) in category_nodes.items():
    value = int(category_values[name])
    ax.text(
        x_category + node_width + 0.010,
        (bottom + top) / 2,
        f"{category_labels[name]}\n{format_count(value)} · {format_percentage(value, total)} %",
        ha="left",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.5,
        color="#17202a",
        bbox=label_box,
        zorder=5,
    )

for x, label in [
    (x_total, "TOTAL MUNICIPAL"),
    (x_type, "TIPUS D'ESTABLIMENT"),
    (x_category, "CATEGORIA REGISTRAL"),
]:
    ax.text(x + node_width / 2, 0.915, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold", color="#52616b")

fig.suptitle(
    "Com es reparteixen 9.985 places d'allotjament registrades a Vila-seca",
    x=0.5,
    y=0.98,
    fontsize=15,
    fontweight="bold",
    color="#17202a",
)
fig.text(
    0.5,
    0.925,
    "Capacitat administrativa registrada: no representa ocupació, pernoctacions ni desplaçaments de persones",
    ha="center",
    fontsize=9.5,
    color="#3f4d55",
)
fig.text(
    0.02,
    0.022,
    "¹ Inclou 5 estrelles, 1 estrella i la categoria «No aplica».\n"
    "Font: Generalitat de Catalunya, Registre de Turisme de Catalunya (t2h3-cgys). "
    "Dades actualitzades el 31-07-2026; consulta 22-08-2026. Sense habitatges d'ús turístic ni llars compartides.",
    ha="left",
    va="bottom",
    fontsize=7.5,
    color="#52616b",
)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.90, bottom=0.11)

output = root / "assets/img/data-visualization/sankey-allotjament-vilaseca.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig(output, format="svg", facecolor="white", metadata={"Date": None})
plt.close(fig)

svg = output.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
output.write_text("\n".join(line.rstrip() for line in svg.splitlines()) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```
